title: Annihilators of affine limits of formal kernels and cokernels
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, $I$ a quasi-coherent ideal, $F,G$ coherent formal $I$-modules [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], and $\alpha:F\to G$. Let $k,c$ be a limiting kernel fork and colimiting cokernel cofork [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-modules-abelian]. For any affine open $V$, put $L(M)=\varprojlim_n\Gamma(V,M_{n+1})$, an $A=\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_X)$-module [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-modules-affine]. Then $\operatorname{Ann}_A L(k)=\operatorname{Ann}_A\operatorname{Ker}(L(\alpha))$ and $\operatorname{Ann}_A L(c)=\operatorname{Ann}_A\operatorname{Coker}(L(\alpha))$.

source.place: Lemma 087X (lemma-inverse-systems-abelian), affine kernel description and exact restriction, together with Lemma 087W (lemma-inverse-systems-affine); verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/087X and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/087W

proof.text: Exact restriction to V preserves the given limiting fork and colimiting cofork.

Identify V with Spec of A. The affine equivalence has underlying A-module the inverse limit of sections and is natural on morphisms. Equivalences preserve kernels and cokernels; finite modules over the Noetherian completion are closed under them, and restriction of scalars preserves both operations. This gives A-linear isomorphisms from L(k) and L(c) to the linear kernel and cokernel of L(alpha).
Apply LinearEquiv.annihilator_eq to both linear isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 087W and Lemma 087X, affine kernel/cokernel calculation; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/087X

theorem coherentFormalModule_limit_annihilators
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData)
    (F G : CoherentFormalModule X I) (α : F ⟶ G)
    (k : KernelFork α) (c : CokernelCofork α) (hk : IsLimit k) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (V : X.affineOpens) :
    Module.annihilator Γ(X, V.1)
      (limit (k.pt.obj ⋙ SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op V.1)) :
        ModuleCat Γ(X, V.1)) =
      Module.annihilator Γ(X, V.1) (LinearMap.ker
        (lim.map (Functor.whiskerRight α.hom
          (SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op V.1)))).hom) ∧
    Module.annihilator Γ(X, V.1)
      (limit (c.pt.obj ⋙ SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op V.1)) :
        ModuleCat Γ(X, V.1)) =
      Module.annihilator Γ(X, V.1)
        (↥(limit (G.obj ⋙ SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op V.1)) :
          ModuleCat Γ(X, V.1)) ⧸ LinearMap.range
          (lim.map (Functor.whiskerRight α.hom
            (SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op V.1)))).hom)
